About Delhi Technological University

Delhi Technological University (formerly DCE) is Delhi's premier state engineering institution, with over 80 years of heritage. Known for exceptional value-for-money education, strong industry connections across Delhi-NCR's booming startup and tech scene, and a vibrant campus culture. DTU graduates are highly sought after by Delhi-NCR product companies and MNCs.
